_comment: Config for the Airflow-orchestrated BATCH consumer (batch_consumer.py).
Unlike the streaming engine (kafka_to_iceberg_v2.py), this job runs once per
trigger: it reads a bounded chunk of new Kafka records (from the consumer
group's last committed offset up to the current end), MERGEs them into
Iceberg, commits the new offsets to Kafka, then EXITS. Airflow re-triggers
it on a schedule (e.g. every 5 minutes).
Offset management = Kafka consumer group (Option A): offsets are committed
ONLY after a successful write, so a mid-run failure causes the next run to
re-read the un-committed records (at-least-once; MERGE idempotency dedups).
spark  -> Spark batch read + MERGE INTO (implemented)
polars -> reserved for a future Polars/PyIceberg writer (NOT yet implemented)
Writes go to a SEPARATE namespace (lakehouse.cdc_batch) so this job never
collides with the streaming job's lakehouse.cdc_v2 tables.
